title: The Stock Barn at Dorris Farms
description:
The Stock Barn is located in the center of a perfectly manicured Tennessee Century Farm, just 25 minutes north of Nashville.  This space features all of the conveniences that you would expect in a modern home, with the rustic feel that dates back to the original construction date of 1900.  The Stock Barn is now a weekend getaway nestled on the farm just north of all that Nashville has to offer.

Other things to note
**No service or emotional support animals
**No WiFi but great cell service
**No cookware or utensils provided
